verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's ingestion story centers on the open-source OpenTelemetry SDKs and OTLP rather than vendor-maintained agents. The only Kubernetes integration evidenced is the Honeycomb Kubernetes Agent, and its docs sit under a 'recommended migrations' path, which implies it is deprecated; the demo's correlation of app and Kubernetes errors adds a little Kubernetes signal. missing for 10: vendor-maintained host agent, container integration, a current (non-deprecated) Kubernetes integration, cloud-service integrations (e.g. AWS/GCP/Azure), independent corroboration.
